events.motivation: Record new P2-03e transportation synthetic source and negative tests as independently reviewable evidence for CAP-BUSINESS, without changing capability maturity, the cross-sector design-only profile, or any operational permission.

after.name: Business Automation
after.implementation_scope: Bounded synthetic-only inventory and cross-functional retail/wholesale/transportation previews plus four draft DENY-only integration declarations; transportation is an offline, fictional trip-capacity experiment, not a contract-v1 activated sector adapter.

verification_evidence.note: Source/CI: fictional retail and wholesale order-to-quote-to-finance invariant tests, with negative cases; no production integration acceptance
PR #65, successful CI 38850185421: fictional trip-capacity, quotes, unsent updates, denied real-world effects, malformed inputs and oversell tests; not operational proof
Source/CI: cross-sector contract v1 denies transportation source promotion and preserves design-only profile; not independent safety certification

after.known_limitations: No real inventory, CRM, booking, driver/passenger identity, route or geolocation, payment, invoice, transport safety assessment, tenant-bound transport API, supplier connection, dispatch or production audit. Transportation remains DESIGN_MAPPING_ONLY in Cross-Sector v1, despite a local synthetic module and successful CI.
after.next_acceptance: Separate review and explicit acceptance of this source-only CAP-BUSINESS evidence refresh; no change to maturity from LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DEMO. Transportation contract reclassification requires a separately versioned proposal/review. Operational use requires Foundation F04-F09 verification, private staging, sector safety/privacy authorization, genuine identity and customer consent.

evidence.scope_note: Fixed, committed fictional fixtures only: trip seat availability, draft quotations, unsent follow-ups, unposted journal illustrations, traceability and repeated/negative deterministic source tests. No transport connector, tenant-owned record, dispatch or live booking.
evidence.known_limits: A PR #65 GitHub CI pass is source-test evidence, not independent verification of transportation safety or a working production platform. No operational controls or private staging were exercised by these sector tests.

dependency_assessments.impact: SYS-DATA's local synthetic inventory/file analysis is not a transport capacity service; no tenant data, customer identity or persistent storage is authorized.
SYS-INTEGRATIONS has draft DENY-only contracts; transportation simulation must not invoke, bind or bypass them. No provider scopes or third-party access.

control_assessments.note: Synthetic output flags human review required; no real approval token, sign-off service or privileged transport operation exists.
Source negative cases and no-effect assertions passed PR #65 CI, but live ingress, side-effect isolation and transport provider boundaries have not been proven.
The offline synthetic transportation module has no tenant principal or database access; per-tenant security is not implemented and cannot be inferred.
Fixture and report SHA-256 are local provenance aids, not tamper-evident production receipts or independently validated audit logs.
